stories.title: KURZMELDUNGEN - Schweiz: SRG verkauft Musiksender an CH Media und Digris AG +++ Wirtschaft wächst 2026 stärker als bisher erwartet

en.title: SHORT ITEMS - Switzerland: SRG sells music station to CH Media and Digris AG +++ Economy to grow stronger in 2026 than previously expected
en.summary: Switzerland's SRG is selling its music radio station to CH Media and Digris AG. Economic growth forecasts for 2026 have been revised upward.

stories.title: Le trafic ferroviaire est interrompu entre Genève et Lausanne suite à une panne électrique

en.title: Railway traffic interrupted between Geneva and Lausanne following electrical failure
en.summary: Train services between Lausanne and Geneva were halted due to a power supply failure, with disruptions expected to last until at least 6:30 PM.

stories.title: Tous les malades d’alzheimer ont les mêmes espoirs, mais pas le même accès aux médicaments

en.title: All Alzheimer's patients share the same hopes, but not equal access to medications
en.summary: A new Alzheimer's medication approved in Switzerland since February is available to very few patients in early disease stages, with narrower eligibility criteria than other countries. Approximately 166,300 people in Switzerland have Alzheimer's or related conditions.

stories.title: Depuis six mois, 200 patients suisses avec la maladie d’Alzheimer reçoivent un nouveau médicament qui ralentit sa progression

en.title: For six months, 200 Swiss Alzheimer's patients receive a new drug that slows disease progression
en.summary: Donanemab, an antibody slowing early Alzheimer's progression, has been available in Switzerland since February, with 200 patients currently receiving treatment under close monitoring due to rare complications.

stories.title: Une collection restituée à la Namibie par le Musée d'histoire de Berne

en.title: A collection returned to Namibia by the Bern History Museum
en.summary: The Bern History Museum is returning a colonial-era collection to the Namibian city of Usakos after 120 years. An exhibition in Bern examines the collection's historical context and future.

stories.title: Es fehlt an Geld – Die Schwimm-EM in der Schweiz steht auf der Kippe

en.title: Money is lacking – The swimming championships in Switzerland are at risk
en.summary: Organizers of the swimming championships in Switzerland must raise over one million francs by the end of September or the event will be cancelled.

stories.title: Une cérémonie de commémoration le 1er janvier 2027 en honneur des victimes de Crans-Montana

en.title: A commemoration ceremony on January 1, 2027 in honor of the victims of Crans-Montana
en.summary: A commemoration ceremony will be held on January 1, 2027, exactly one year after the Constellation fire in Crans-Montana, led by the State of Valais in collaboration with the municipality.

stories.title: Le Valais va organiser une cérémonie en hommage aux victimes de l'incendie de Crans-Montana, un an après le drame

en.title: Valais to organize a ceremony in tribute to the victims of the Crans-Montana fire, one year after the tragedy
en.summary: The State of Valais and the municipality will hold a commemoration ceremony on January 1, 2027, gathering bereaved families, injured persons, rescue workers, and Swiss and foreign officials.

stories.title: Le Conseil d'Etat genevois table sur un déficit de plus de 540 millions en 2027, un plan d'économie prévu

en.title: Geneva State Council projects deficit of over 540 million in 2027, cost-cutting plan planned
en.summary: Geneva's 2027 budget projects a deficit of 546.2 million francs with a cost-cutting plan of 247.7 million francs. The government is urging the parliament to take responsibility amid financial concerns.

stories.title: Le Conseil national accepte de débloquer 20 millions pour la table ronde de Crans-Montana après un débat sur la solidarité fédérale

en.title: National Council approves 20 million francs for Crans-Montana round table after debate on federal solidarity
en.summary: Switzerland's National Council approved 20 million francs in federal funding to address consequences of the Crans-Montana fire through a coordination roundtable. The measure passed with 106 votes against 87 after earlier approval by the Council of States.

stories.title: Genève prévoit un déficit de 550 millions de francs pour 2027, malgré près de 250 millions d’économies supplémentaires

en.title: Geneva plans 550 million franc deficit for 2027, despite nearly 250 million in additional savings
en.summary: Geneva's 2027 budget forecast shows a 550 million franc deficit despite implementing approximately 250 million francs in cost-saving measures derived partly from the Zuin report.

stories.title: Près d'un milliard de francs de dommages annoncés pour la grêle qui a frappé fin août

en.title: Nearly one billion francs in damages announced for hailstorm that struck in late August
en.summary: A hailstorm that hit Switzerland in late August caused approximately one billion francs in insured damages, according to the Swiss Insurance Association. This figure accounts only for claims to cantonal property insurers.

stories.title: Helene Budliger hat die Zollverhandlungen mit den USA geprägt – wie geht es nun weiter?

en.title: Helene Budliger shaped tariff negotiations with the USA – what happens next?
en.summary: The outgoing Seco director played a key role in Swiss tariff talks with the United States, earning praise from the Swiss business community for her efforts, though overall success remains uncertain.

stories.title: Soziale Netzwerke: Kinder sollten wieder Kinder sein, sagt die EU-Kommissions-Präsidentin Ursula von der Leyen

en.title: Social networks: Children should be children again, says EU Commission President Ursula von der Leyen
en.summary: The EU Commission proposes age-differentiated strict rules for social media use by minors under 18, with a legislative approach that differs significantly from how the United States regulates platforms.

stories.title: INTERAKTIV - Unsere interaktive Karte zeigt, wo und wie Russland in Europa zündelt

en.title: INTERACTIVE - Our interactive map shows where and how Russia is stirring trouble in Europe
en.summary: Moscow is testing European defensive capabilities through provocations away from the Ukraine battlefield. The report examines whether these actions represent preparation for a major attack.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Kanada und die EU: Aus dem Flirt könnte rasch eine enttäuschte Liebe werden

en.title: COMMENTARY - Canada and the EU: A flirtation could quickly become disappointed love
en.summary: Trump's policies are pushing Canada toward closer ties with Europe, though analysts question whether this will develop into a genuine strong alliance.

stories.title: KURZMELDUNGEN - Wirtschaft: RTL Deutschland und Sky streichen rund 500 Stellen +++ Helvetia Baloise legt erstmals nach Fusion Halbjahresergebnis vor

en.title: BRIEFS - Economy: RTL Deutschland and Sky cutting around 500 jobs +++ Helvetia Baloise reports half-year results for first time after merger
en.summary: RTL Deutschland and Sky are reducing their workforce by approximately 500 positions. Helvetia Baloise released its first combined half-year financial results following their merger.
